result_text:
Any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` now counts as a mock-resources folder, whatever follows in the name. That covers plain `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/`, `mock-größe/` and `mock模拟/`. The existing `*Convention*` tests pass, but I didn't add a test for the new cases or check them directly.

The change is in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/TestConventions.java`. The two mock-folder rules used `[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+` after the prefix, which needed at least one ASCII letter, digit, underscore, dash or space. I replaced that with `[^/]*`. The match stays inside one folder name, so `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, and files named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` are still not matched. `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` still match.

Windows paths already work. `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` normalizes backslashes to `/` before matching, so I didn't change anything for that.

The rules still require a `/` before the folder name, as before. A bare relative path like `mock/x.java` with no parent folder is not caught.
